It's great that you've found something that boosts your confidence. Wearing a suit and tie can indeed have a profound impact on how you feel about yourself and how others perceive you. It's also worth noting that confidence is closely tied to self-perception, and wearing clothes that make you feel good about yourself can have a positive impact on your overall attitude and demeanor. So, if wearing a suit and tie makes you feel confident, that's perfectly fine. Own it, and use it to your advantage.
